title: Statistics, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Confirmed identical to the 2026 edition, verified by fetching the archive page directly (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2025-2026/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/statistics-bs/). The Statistics and Computing Option's prescribed courses (CMPSC 131/132/465, CMPSC 360 or MATH 311W), Suggested Academic Plan course-by-semester sequence, the 'Select 12 credits from the following' Advanced elective pool (BBH/HPA 440, CMPSC 448, IE 434, IE 436, MATH 436 or 441, MATH/CMPSC 451 or 455, STAT/MATH 416, STAT 440, STAT 463, STAT 464, STAT 466 -- no RM 415/420, unlike 2022-2024, see STAT-2024.json's notes), and the 'Select 8 credits from department list' Supporting Courses total all matched the live 2026 bulletin text word-for-word. Same MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 -> STAT 200/STAT 184 prereq-chain fix carried over unchanged from STAT-2026.json: Backend/catalogs/stat_catalog.json (STAT 200 and STAT 184 both have prereq_groups [['MATH 21']]) is a single catalog file shared by every catalog-year plan, not duplicated per year, so the same literal MATH 21 prereq applies identically to this file regardless of catalog_year -- omitting the fix here would leave STAT 200/184 prereq-blocked in Semester 1 exactly as it would have in STAT-2026.json before that file's own 2026-08-27 correction. Everything else (departments list, max_credits_per_semester, elective pool mechanics) copied unchanged from STAT-2026.json since no real difference was found.
